items.title: Buddy Burton Interview, 1959-09-07
items.q: And that was the first time that Hink heard me play and sing by myself.

ctx.x: The same number. Oh, yeah. I noticed some of those numbers there are the same thing. That's what that's what they're saying.

And that's the reason why they killed it on the market. And they had signed up for six parts to the thing. And they had them all rolled out and everything ready for it. Yeah. And I said, Mr. Melrose, you know what you're doing now. I said, won't this get us in trouble? I'll take care of all that. I said, okay. I said, I want to make money. It's true. I want to make all the money I can. So I went on down. And so, Hink Williams was standing back at the door when Jimmy Blythe was there with me. And that was the…
So I wonder if you could start a little bit at the very beginning, just when you were born and where too.
